messages:
jordan: Hey folks — opened a small cleanup PR that splits up exports in core/utils into core/exports and core/compat, and ran `yarn lint --fix`. Mostly moves + a couple renames, no behavioral changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4827 Can someone take a quick pass for style and module-boundary concerns? @maya @priya — would appreciate eyes on the import/typedef changes.

maya: I can take a look in ~30m. Quick heads-up: last time we split these files there was an import path that broke the build; please run `yarn build` before pushing.

priya: On it. I'll focus on the types and whether any private helpers leaked out of the module boundary. If it's just re-exports we should be fine.

sam: skimming now — left one comment about moving `helpers/format.ts` -> `lib/format.ts` instead of `utils/format.ts` since it's used by multiple subsystems. Also seeing `core/compat/index.ts` still exporting `internalFoo` — is that intentional?

jordan: Good catch — not intentional, thanks. Pushed a fix: removed `internalFoo` export and updated call sites. Also added a tiny unit test for the renamed helper.

ci-bot: CI: GitHub Actions • redwood-inference/platform — lint failed on node-18 · https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/actions/runs/12345678 (logs)

maya: Reproduced the lint failure locally — it's from the new `no-relative-parent-imports` rule. Suggest we disable for this PR with a code comment and open a follow-up to migrate imports. Patch idea: add `// eslint-disable-next-line no-relative-parent-imports` to the moved files for now.

priya: I ran the type checks, one minor change needed in `types/core.d.ts` for the renamed export; pushed that commit.

sam: Tests passing locally for me after those fixes. Left one more nit about a comment. Otherwise LGTM.

maya: Looks good to me as well. Approved on GitHub.

sam: Approved and running the merge job. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks y'all — I'll wait an hour for any last objections then merge. If CI flakes, I'll revert and open a follow-up.

priya: Sounds good. Thanks for cleaning up the exports — should make future refactors easier.

maya: Thanks — nice tidy-up.

jordan: Merged at 1763004834. Will keep an eye on post-merge CI.
